paper_title: On the Complexity of Recognizing k^+-Real Face Graphs
classifications: Theory of computation → Graph algorithms analysis
statement: A question that directly stems from our research is whether 2-layer 1+ -real face graphs can be recognized efficiently. In the unconstrained scenario, are there subfamilies of k + -real face graphs that can be recognized efficiently? Also, are there meaningful parameterizations that make the recognition problem tractable?
